Karthik / Mina —

Thanks for the ping. I'm Jordan, lead consultant at PentestCo (we completed the external engagement on 2025-03-15). Short answers up front:
- Methodology: OWASP ASVS v4 mappings, external network and authenticated web app testing, manual exploit validation, and proof-of-concept where applicable. We include risk ratings mapped to OWASP + CVSS. Full statement attached.
- Firm credentials: PentestCo is CREST-aligned, we carry cyber liability insurance, and our lead holds OSCP and CREST Registered Tester credentials (see attached CV).
- Report age/validity: Typically vendors and auditors view an external assessment as "current" for 12 months. Beyond that, auditors often accept the prior report if there have been no material infra, architecture, or high-risk product changes and if the vendor provides an attestation and remediation evidence. A short external re-scan (1–3 days) to validate fixes is often requested as a compromise.
- Remediation: Per our records, critical findings were closed by 2025-04-10; medium items were addressed on a rolling schedule, with a few low-risk findings deferred (see redacted exec summary).

Attachments: pentest_statement_of_methodology.pdf; pentest_vendor_creds_jordan_ellis.pdf; redacted_executive_summary_2025-03.pdf

If Opsly wants a vendor-signed attestation, we can provide a one-paragraph attestation confirming the scope and that no additional high-risk findings were discovered in follow-up scans. Pricing for a delta scan: typically $3k-$7k depending on scope (external surface + authenticated areas). Lead time: 1–3 weeks from PO depending on scheduling.

Happy to hop on a quick call with Opsly and Redwood to walk through the documents.

Best,
Jordan Ellis

Since that date, Redwood has not made material changes to the public external attack surface and has remediated critical findings as documented in the attached remediation tracker. A short external delta scan is available upon request to confirm fixes."

If Opsly prefers a stronger signal, we can coordinate a vendor-led delta scan (1–3 business days work; Jordan indicated typical cost $3k–$7k). If you want us to proceed with scheduling, we can send a PO/engagement terms.
